shared_elements: figures shown in profile in low relief
quadruped/animal body in profile with hatched or striated infill
incised linear detailing used for hair, mane or feathering
curving vegetal or snake-like linear motif
justification: Both surfaces are figural low-relief panels using strict profile presentation and dense parallel incision to fill textured areas (a mane in A, wings and hair in B), which is a broadly comparable carving convention. But the depicted content differs substantially: A is a multi-register composition with an arcaded architectural band, small figures and a large maned quadruped, while B shows a single large kneeling bearded winged figure with a horned cap reaching toward a stylised palmette plant — none of B's distinctive attributes (wings, plant, headgear, raised hand) appear in A.
